This supports a source-contract specializes direction from the German default to the R04 role, not full equivalence.

### `pcheey`: R04 preparation/form-II field, with zero dry evidence

There are only three exact occurrences, but all three immediately follow `sho` or `sheo`, and two form a `pcheey-X-daiin` construction. All three are medial in paragraph-opening lines. This repeated bounded-field geometry supports R04 and the neutral reader phrase `gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld`.

The dry frame F03 has zero support. There is also no independent vessel, operation, passage/straining, or closing signal. A previous powder-like reading inherited from the shape of EVA `p` is therefore excluded from the default. Paste, salve, mixed form, or residue after soaking remain possible identities, but none is selected.

5. Nur innerhalb einer tragfähigen Rolle konkrete Identitätskarten werten.

   Signatur auf einer zweiten Seite erneut prüfen.

decisions.scope_limit: This is specialization between the two authored historical pcheey contracts only, not a confirmed semantic taxonomy or corpus-derived entailment. Gate formulas and observed frame summaries are source-authored assumptions; no observations were rerun or independently verified. I10 explicitly names neither substance nor state of matter. Preparation/Form-II does not identify paste, salve, powder, residue, a physical second grade or any real ingredient. I37 retains paste/salve/mixed-form as a separate more concrete challenger even under the same F11/F04 signature. A stronger operational signature alone does not prove a narrower meaning; the direction also relies on explicit required_role_model plus the narrower named candidate/renderer. R04 can cover record/form/measure fields without the added preparation/moist context. Preserve both full cards and all three cases, source timing and unconfirmed status. No C1/C2 role label or default_is_translation=0 field becomes meaning support. No merge or new experiment.
